quests.instruction: Which list shows the safest order for making a chicken stir-fry?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, keep raw chicken apart, cook it through, serve hot 🍳
options: Wash hands, keep raw chicken apart, cook it through, serve hot 🍳
Cook it through, serve hot, wash hands, keep raw chicken apart 🍳
Serve hot, wash hands, cook it through, keep raw chicken apart 🍳
quests.hint: Clean hands and separate raw meat come before cooking.
quests.explanation: Hands are washed first, raw chicken is kept apart from other foods, the chicken is cooked all the way through, and the meal is served hot.
quests.funFact: A stir-fry cooks quickly, so the chicken is cut into small pieces to get hot all the way through.

quests.instruction: Which traditional meal naturally combines a grain, a legume and vegetables?
quests.hint: Dal is made from lentils.
quests.explanation: Rice is a grain, dal is made from lentils, which are legumes, and the curry holds vegetables. The other meals have only one or two kinds of food.
quests.funFact: Rice with dal is an everyday meal in many parts of South Asia.

quests.instruction: A 1-liter carton holds 1,000 milliliters. How many 250-milliliter glasses can be filled from it?
quests.hint: Ask yourself how many 250s make 1,000.
quests.explanation: Four glasses of 250 milliliters make 1,000 milliliters, which is one liter.
quests.funFact: A cup in many metric kitchen sets holds about 250 milliliters.

quests.instruction: A kitchen has stale bread, a very ripe banana and cold cooked rice. Which plan uses all three safely?
quests.correctAnswer: Make croutons and banana bread, chill the rice 🍞
options: Make croutons, leave the rice out overnight 🌙
Make croutons and banana bread, chill the rice 🍞
Throw away the banana and keep the rest 🗑️
quests.hint: Cooked rice belongs in the fridge.
quests.explanation: Stale bread makes croutons, a ripe banana makes banana bread and the rice should be chilled for another meal. Rice left out overnight is not safe.
quests.funFact: Stale bread, ripe bananas and leftover rice can all find new life as other dishes.

quests.instruction: Tortillas, naan and injera are breads from different cultures. Which of these is NOT a flatbread?
quests.hint: One of them is a rice dish, not a bread.
quests.explanation: Pita and roti are flatbreads. Risotto is a creamy rice dish.
quests.funFact: Flatbreads are made all over the world, often because they cook quickly on a flat pan.

quests.instruction: The power goes out at home. What helps keep the food in the freezer frozen for longer?
quests.hint: Opening it lets warm air rush in.
quests.explanation: A closed freezer keeps the cold air inside. Opening it lets warm air in, and the counter is far too warm.
quests.funFact: A full freezer stays cold longer than a half-empty one.

quests.instruction: Cereal A has 5 grams of fiber in a serving and cereal B has 2 grams. Which gives more fiber?
quests.hint: Compare the two numbers.
quests.explanation: Five grams is more than two grams, so cereal A gives more fiber in each serving.
quests.funFact: Labels list nutrients per serving, so servings must be compared fairly.

quests.instruction: A tray of cookies goes into the oven at 3:10 and needs 20 minutes. When should it come out?
quests.hint: Add twenty minutes to ten past three.
quests.explanation: Ten past three plus twenty minutes is half past three.
quests.funFact: Cooks set timers because ovens can be hard to judge by eye.

quests.instruction: Which holds more: half a cup of milk or a quarter cup of milk?
quests.hint: Think about cutting a cup into parts.
quests.explanation: Half a cup is two quarter cups, so it holds twice as much.
quests.funFact: A cup divided into four quarters shows why half is twice as much as a quarter.

quests.instruction: A school holds an international food day. Which plan is the most respectful?
quests.correctAnswer: Families share dishes and their stories 🌍
options: Families share dishes and their stories 🌍
Only dishes from one country are allowed 🚩
Dishes are ranked from best to worst 🏆
quests.hint: Everyone's food should be welcome.
quests.explanation: Sharing dishes with their stories welcomes every family, and labels help guests with allergies. Allowing only one country or ranking dishes leaves people out.
quests.funFact: Labels that list ingredients help guests with allergies and with food rules.

quests.instruction: Rice dishes are common in many Asian countries, while potatoes are a staple in the Andes. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: Different crops thrive in different climates 🌦️
options: People in Asia simply dislike potatoes 😖
Rice can only grow in the Andes mountains ⛰️
Different crops thrive in different climates 🌦️
quests.hint: Think about rain, warmth and height above the sea.
quests.explanation: Rice likes warm, wet places and potatoes do well in cool highlands, so each became a staple where it grows best.
quests.funFact: Many cuisines were shaped by which crops could grow nearby.

quests.instruction: It is winter in a cool country. Which fruit will probably cost the most at the shop?
quests.hint: Think about when strawberries grow there.
quests.explanation: Strawberries are out of season in winter, so they have to be grown far away or in heated greenhouses, which costs more. Stored apples and canned peaches keep well.
quests.funFact: Fruit from far away or from heated greenhouses costs more to bring to the shop.

quests.instruction: At a buffet, hot soup is kept hot and salads are kept on ice. Why?
options: So the ice does not go to waste 🧊
quests.hint: Ask yourself what germs like.
quests.explanation: Keeping hot food hot and cold food cold stops germs from growing quickly.
quests.funFact: Many buffets use covers and warming trays to keep hot food hot.

quests.instruction: A child with a nut allergy is baking. Why should the bowls and spoons be washed first?
quests.correctAnswer: Traces of nuts can stay on tools 🥜
options: Traces of nuts can stay on tools 🥜
Clean tools help the cake bake faster ⏩
quests.hint: A tiny amount can matter.
quests.explanation: Traces of nuts left on a dirty bowl or spoon could reach the food and cause a reaction.
quests.funFact: Even a tiny trace of an allergen can cause a reaction, which is why careful cleaning matters.

quests.instruction: Which label is best for someone who wants to avoid added sugar?
quests.hint: Read the whole ingredients list.
quests.explanation: Only the first label lists just the fruit. The others add sugar syrup or honey.
quests.funFact: Added sugars can appear under many names, such as syrup, honey and cane sugar.

quests.instruction: Which lunch includes foods from all five food groups?
quests.correctAnswer: A bean-cheese burrito, salsa and an orange 🌯
options: Pasta with butter and a warm bread roll 🍝
A bean-cheese burrito, salsa and an orange 🌯
A big cheese pizza with a large cola 🍕
quests.hint: Count grain, protein, dairy, vegetable and fruit.
quests.explanation: The tortilla is a grain, beans are protein, cheese is dairy, salsa is mostly vegetables and the orange is fruit. The other lunches are missing groups.
quests.funFact: Salsa counts toward vegetables because it is made mostly from tomatoes and onions.

quests.instruction: Which pair of foods is made from the same staple grain?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what each one is made from.
quests.explanation: Arepas and tortillas are both made from corn. Naan and pasta use wheat, sushi uses rice, and dosa uses rice and lentils.
quests.funFact: Corn is ground into masa, the dough behind tortillas, tamales and many other foods.

quests.instruction: Which food change cannot be undone by cooling or warming it again?
quests.hint: Think about which change can go back.
quests.explanation: Heat permanently changes an egg, so a cooked egg cannot become raw again. Ice and chocolate can freeze or harden again.
quests.funFact: Heat permanently changes the proteins in an egg, so cooked eggs cannot become raw again.

quests.instruction: A family cooks a big pot of beans. Which plan keeps them safe and useful all week?
quests.correctAnswer: Cool quickly, store in small tubs, freeze some 🫘
options: Cool quickly, store in small tubs, freeze some 🫘
Keep the whole pot on the counter in the sun ☀️
Leave the pot on the stove for the whole week 🍲
quests.hint: Cool fast and keep cold.
quests.explanation: Cooling quickly, storing small tubs in the fridge and freezing some keeps the beans safe and ready for later.
quests.funFact: Beans freeze well, so a big batch can turn into several quick meals.

quests.instruction: Which foods are the best sources of fiber?
quests.hint: Fiber comes only from plants.
quests.explanation: Beans, oats and vegetables come from plants and contain fiber. Dairy and animal foods have none.
quests.funFact: Swapping white bread for whole-grain bread is an easy way to add fiber.

quests.instruction: On a menu, a dish marked with a V usually means what?
quests.hint: It is about what the dish is made from.
quests.explanation: A V on a menu usually shows that a dish is vegetarian. Spicy dishes use a pepper symbol instead.
quests.funFact: Menus use small symbols to help people with different diets choose quickly.

quests.instruction: A cook has no lemons for lemonade. Which fruit could replace their sour taste?
quests.hint: It is green and citrusy.
quests.explanation: Limes are sour citrus fruits, like lemons. Bananas and peaches are sweet.
quests.funFact: Limes and lemons are both citrus fruits.

quests.instruction: Which cooks faster in boiling water: a whole potato or the same potato cut into small cubes?
quests.hint: Heat has less distance to travel.
quests.explanation: Small pieces cook faster because heat reaches the middle sooner. A grown-up should do the cutting.
quests.funFact: Small pieces cook faster because heat reaches their centers sooner.

quests.instruction: Which weather is best for drying fruit in the sun?
quests.hint: Ask yourself how water leaves the fruit.
quests.explanation: Hot, dry, sunny weather helps water leave the fruit. Wet, cloudy or foggy weather would slow drying and could spoil the fruit.
quests.funFact: Sun-drying is an old way of keeping fruit such as grapes, apricots and figs.

quests.instruction: Which dinner best matches the idea of filling half the plate with vegetables and fruit?
quests.correctAnswer: Mostly vegetables, with some rice and tofu 🥗
options: Mostly vegetables, with some rice and tofu 🥗
Mostly meat, with just a little rice 🍖
Mostly rice, with just a little vegetable 🍚
quests.hint: Look at which plate has the most plant foods.
quests.explanation: The first dinner is mostly vegetables, with a grain and a protein food. The other dinners have much less.
quests.funFact: A stir-fry or a big salad with a side of rice is an easy way to fill half the plate with plants.

quests.instruction: A recipe from another country uses an ingredient name you do not know. What is a good first step?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up or look it up 📖
options: Ask a grown-up or look it up 📖
Guess and cook the dish anyway 🤷
quests.hint: Finding out beats guessing.
quests.explanation: Asking or looking it up tells you what the ingredient is and where to find it. Guessing can ruin the dish.
quests.funFact: Many shops sell ingredients from around the world, and staff can help you find them.

quests.instruction: Which statement about food chains is true?
quests.correctAnswer: Plants make food; animals eat to get it 🌱
options: Animals make their food from sunlight 🐄
Plants eat animals to help them grow 🌿
Plants make food; animals eat to get it 🌱
quests.hint: Ask yourself where the energy comes from.
quests.explanation: Plants make their own food from sunlight, and animals get food by eating plants or other animals.
quests.funFact: People are part of food chains too, eating both plants and animals.

quests.instruction: Which dinner plan is balanced, uses plant protein and is easy to keep safe and affordable?
quests.correctAnswer: Rice and bean stew with carrots and oranges 🍲
options: Pasta with cheese and a glass of milk 🍝
Rice and bean stew with carrots and oranges 🍲
Rice and white bread with butter and jam 🍞
quests.hint: Check for a grain, a protein food, a vegetable and a fruit.
quests.explanation: Rice is a grain, beans are plant protein, carrots are a vegetable and oranges are fruit. The other plans are missing vegetables or fruit.
quests.funFact: Beans and rice are pantry staples that keep for a long time when they are dried.

quests.instruction: Which statement is the best summary of enjoying food safely and respectfully?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, check dates and respect others' choices 🌍
options: Only eat foods that come from your own culture 🚩
Eat quickly, ignore dates and judge others' foods 😤
Wash hands, check dates and respect others' choices 🌍
quests.hint: It combines hygiene, safety and kindness.
quests.explanation: Washing hands and checking dates keeps food safe, and respecting others' choices makes everyone feel welcome.
quests.funFact: Good food habits keep us healthy and help everyone feel welcome at the table.

quests.instruction: A sandwich has whole-grain bread, cheese, lettuce and tomato. Which list gives the food group of each, in that order?
quests.hint: Use what you learned about grains, dairy and vegetables.
quests.explanation: Bread is a grain, cheese is dairy and lettuce and tomato are counted as vegetables in food guides.
quests.funFact: A sandwich can bring together food from a wheat field, a dairy farm and a vegetable garden.
